default.question: What happens when my trial ends?
default.answer: Your Premium subscription will automatically continue at the regular price. You can cancel anytime before your trial ends to avoid being charged.

default.question: Can I cancel anytime?
default.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription anytime. Your Premium benefits will continue until the end of your billing period.

default.question: What payment methods do you accept?
default.answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, PayPal, and various other payment methods depending on your region.

default.question: How do I download music for offline listening?
default.answer: With Premium, simply tap the download button on any song, album, or playlist to save it for offline listening.
